name: Nexa Agent v4.2.1 — NUL-byte Path Traversal Fix
body:
## What's fixed

- **Security (P0)**: `tools/_paths.py::resolve_in_workspace` now rejects NUL bytes, control characters (<U+0020), DEL (U+007F), and empty/whitespace-only paths. Before this fix, an attacker could smuggle `safe.txt\x00.evil.ps1` past the workspace-path verifier — on Windows, `CreateFileW` treats NUL as a terminator, so a tool could have written to a different file than the one it believed in.
- Two new unit tests in `tests/test_file_tools_hardened.py::TestPathHygiene` lock the behavior in.
- QA session report added at `.plans/qa/QA-RESULTS-v4.2.0-session-drop.md`.
- Test count went 633 → 636 (+2 path hygiene tests).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/neuralforgeio/nexa-agent/compare/v4.2.0...v4.2.1
